answer_4.quote: We recruited 12 users to label GPT-3 generated data in the subgroup augmentation step. All users ... were assigned a high-error cluster ... and asked to label GPT-3 generations. Sentences that users labeled differently from the model's prediction were added to the augmented set.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each GPT-3 generated example and add it to the augmentation set if the label differs from the model prediction or if there is a disagreement between the global and local models.
